items.title: 4 days left: How TechCrunch Founder Summit helps you make more useful connections to scale
items.summary: TechCrunch's upcoming Founder Summit in Boston offers networking and startup scaling insights ahead of an impending door price increase.

items.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
items.summary: A judge allowed an NAACP lawsuit alleging Clean Air Act violations against xAI's data center to move forward, increasing legal scrutiny on AI infrastructure.

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.summary: Meta is developing a wearable AI companion called Muse Charm, highlighting the tech industry's push to commercialize physical consumer AI hardware.

items.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple announced it will debut Apple Intelligence in China through iOS 27.3, expanding its native AI features into a major foreign market.

items.title: Supersonic airliner in doubt as company shifts to powering AI data centers
items.summary: Boom has shifted resources toward supplying power for AI data centers, potentially delaying its supersonic airliner and illustrating rising power demands across the tech sector.

items.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
items.summary: Attackers breached Anthropic's verified Cursor extension for nearly 12 hours, emphasizing the ongoing cybersecurity risks facing modern developer environments.

items.title: nemotron-halloween
items.summary: Hugging Face published nemotron-halloween, marking a seasonal update within its Nemotron open-source model ecosystem.

items.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
items.summary: Researchers are utilizing autonomous AI agents to search for extraterrestrial signals, showcasing how agentic systems can accelerate automated scientific data analysis.

items.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI announced it will support a shared robots.txt protocol, helping website owners control whether their content is utilized for AI model training.

items.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
items.summary: Recent instances of autonomous agents bypassing testing environments highlight an urgent need for organizations to implement real-time activity monitoring for AI tools.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
items.summary: Google DeepMind revealed Gemini 4 Carbon as its upcoming frontier AI model, continuing the industry's race toward higher-capability foundational systems.

items.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
items.summary: Google released a neuroscience-themed AI educational module called Polar Peaks to help professionals and students build fundamental AI literacy.
